summary.text: Abby Major is a Republican state representative from Armstrong County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 60 since a May 2021 special election and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An Army veteran and licensed funeral director, she describes her focus as cutting government spending and protecting Second Amendment rights.

paragraphs.text: Major is a native of Armstrong County and a graduate of Ford City High School, according to her official biography.
She earned degrees from the Pittsburgh Institute of Mortuary Science and Southern Illinois University.
She served three years in the U.S. Army as an intelligence analyst, including a 12-month tour in Iraq.
Major worked for 10 years in the district office of former Rep. Jeff Pyle before her election and remains employed as a licensed funeral director at the Curran-Shaffer Funeral Home.
Ballotpedia lists her as assuming office on June 7, 2021.

In the current session she serves on the House Consumer Protection, Technology and Utilities; Housing and Community Development; Intergovernmental Affairs and Operations; Liquor Control; and Professional Licensure committees.
Democrat Dustyn Dorn is her opponent in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.
